user.title: Codex Token Pool
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to a Codex-compatible reverse proxy that exposes the OpenAI Responses API.

data_description.base_url: Root URL of the proxy. The integration will append /v1/responses automatically.
data_description.model: Initial model id; you can switch later in the conversation agent options.
data_description.toml_config: If you already use Codex CLI, paste the entire config.toml here and base_url, model, reasoning effort and store flag will be filled in for you.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the proxy. Check the URL and your network.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by the proxy.
error.unknown_model: The proxy does not recognize this model. Try gpt-5.5 or another value from /v1/models.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the proxy.
error.bad_toml: Could not parse the pasted TOML.

data_description.store_responses: Off mirrors Codex CLI's disable_response_storage = true.
data_description.reasoning_effort: xhigh = the deepest reasoning Codex supports; medium is faster.
